scope.purpose: Combined completeness/current-norm audit of the remaining compact Grade-7 adverb and НЕ/НИ bank records; no physical bank mutation.

current_academic_crosscheck.source: Gramota.ru — current academic adverb spelling rules
Gramota.ru — Russian Orthographic Dictionary: не сегодня завтра
Gramota.ru — current academic/learning rule: НЕ with participles

decisions.current_source_correction: The Grade-7 source form не сегодня-завтра is obsolete for current orthography; the Russian Orthographic Dictionary fixes не сегодня завтра separately. By contrast, сегодня-завтра without НЕ can be hyphenated in the meaning 'very soon'.
decisions.dedupe_note: точь-в-точь remains owned by school-soft-sign-toch-v-toch; it is provenance here, not a second denominator identity.

decisions.current_rule_note: The academic adverb rule explicitly preserves these separate spellings; В ОТКРЫТУЮ additionally follows the rule for В + a vowel-initial second part. The set may be practised together without inventing one derivation for all four.

decisions.learner_policy: Keep as a small dictionary-spelling group; no pseudo-rule.

decisions.current_rule_note: Academic rules explicitly contrast В-/НА- collective-numeral adverbs written solid with ПО + numeral combinations written separately; ПООДИНОЧКЕ is separately fixed solid.

decisions.learner_policy: The source creates one dictionary-spelling learning task across heterogeneous words. Keep one denominator identity, but runtime practice may shard the list into manageable exercise clusters without changing the denominator.
decisions.norm_note: Prior itemwise project review is retained; no current rule justifies splitting 29 surface words into 29 canonical knowledge identities.

current_separate_core: full genuine participle with relevant dependent words
decisions.current_solid_core: full participle without a separate-writing trigger is commonly solid with НЕ, subject to lexical and morphological exceptions
decisions.important_caution: The dependent-word shortcut is valid only after identifying a genuine participle. Verb-derived adjectives can have dependent words without automatically switching to separate НЕ; semantic/morphological classification remains primary.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the existing learner decision but make the adjective-vs-participle guardrail prominent.

decisions.current_model: In constructions like не мог не + infinitive, the second particle is НЕ. The combination of two negatives yields an affirmative/unavoidability meaning: the action did occur or could not be avoided.
decisions.learner_policy: Do not replace the second НЕ with НИ merely because there are two negative-looking elements.

current_models.concessive_generalizing: pronominal word + НИ in a subordinate clause whose main-clause truth holds regardless of the condition, e.g. куда ни поеду
current_models.interrogative_exclamatory: НЕ in interrogative/exclamatory structures such as куда только не... expressing breadth/intensity despite negative form

decisions.learner_policy: Classify the clause type and meaning first; surface pronominal words alone do not choose the particle.

current_branches.particle: single НИ reinforces an explicit or structurally implied negation, e.g. не слышно ни звука
current_branches.repeating_conjunction: НИ… НИ coordinates homogeneous members inside a negative construction, e.g. не слышно ни шорохов, ни голосов

decisions.counting_policy: Keep one learner boundary with two functional branches; do not count the particle and repeating-conjunction branches as two knowledge identities.

cumulative_audit_progress.note: Audit counters only; not readiness percentages.

next: Audit the 24-unit Grade-8 cross-grade bank in 214, with special attention to semantic duplicates against already audited cross-grade identities.
